flagged_bars.issue: Saying an AP system 'syncs the data right' during a partition contradicts the core AP trade-off (serving unsynchronized/stale data during the split and only achieving eventual consistency later).
flagged_bars.suggested_fix_direction: Emphasize that an AP system stays online/scrolling now and only reaches eventual consistency later (e.g., 'An AP system scrolls the feed till eventual consistency makes it right' or 'though data's out of sight').

overall_notes: Bars 1 through 7 accurately capture replication, network partitions, and the C vs. A trade-off using the approved analogies. Bar 8 needs a minor tweak so it doesn't imply that an AP system is actively synchronized during the partition.
